name: tower-tabs
purpose: 결정 40 — 관제탑 서브 탭 둘(팀·개인) 배치 확인용 목업 한 장. 데스크톱과 폰을 나란히. 화면에 안 올라간다. 설계 정본은 out/opsroom-tower-tabs.md.
prompt: Create a clean, flat UI mockup image (no photo, no 3D, no gradients, no shadows except a 1px border) of a web dashboard called 관제탑 (control tower), showing TWO screens side by side on a single canvas: LEFT a desktop view 1216x820 px, RIGHT a phone view 412x915 px. Use exactly this warm paper palette: page background #e7e0d3, card background #f4efe4, panel #fdfbf7, hairline borders #d6cdbb, main text #1c1a17, secondary text #4a443b, muted text #7a7266 and #9a9184, alert red #b3261e, live green #2f7d4f, approval yellow #d9b23f, deep teal #0f5b52. Typography: Korean sans (like IBM Plex Sans KR) for body 12.5px; a Korean serif (like Gowun Batang) for the page title 19px and team names 16px; a monospace (like IBM Plex Mono) 9.5-10.5px letter-spaced for small labels, pills and numbers. DESKTOP (left): a 224px left rail with a small logo and a vertical menu (작전실 / 관제탑 [selected] / 분석 / 마을), then the main area: header '관제탑' with a small grey subtitle, below it a tab bar with two pill buttons '팀' and '개인 ·1' (개인 selected, the '1' in red mono). Under the tabs, a pinned wide card for the boss: round chip '댄', name '함동혁 · 대표', right side pill '자리에', border color #d9b23f. Then five group headers in small letter-spaced mono grey text: '총괄 2', '마케팅 3', '개발 3', '디자인 3', '재무 3', each followed by a 3-column grid of person cards (fifteen cards total; show at least the first three groups fully, the rest may be cut off at the bottom). Each person card (border 1px #d6cdbb, radius 10, padding 12x14): row 1 = a 26px round chip with initials in a team color (navy #2f4f7a, green #4a5d3a, blue-violet #4b5f9e, teal #1f5f4f, brown #6b4a2f, orange #c96f3b etc.), name 13.5px medium + ' · ' + role 11px grey (e.g. '헨리 · 메인 디자인'), and at the right a small mono pill: '일하는 중' green outline, or '대기' grey outline, or '대표 부름' solid red; row 2 = one line of what they are doing in 12.5px dark grey (e.g. 'direction.md 3절 카메라 고치는 중'); row 3 = mono 10.5px grey '신호 2분 전 · 오늘 발언 14 · 판정 0'; row 4 (only on ONE card, 헨리) = red text '대표 불렀음 · 12분 전 · "손 하나 빌리겠…"' and that card also has a 3px red stripe inside its left edge; row 5 = a serif quote in grey inside Korean corner brackets 「나는 헨리, 예쁜 그림보다 구도를 먼저…」. PHONE (right): same app at 412px wide, single column: top bar with menu icon and a bell icon with a red '1' badge at top right; title '관제탑'; the same two tab pills full width, '팀' selected this time; then a stack of five TEAM cards, each: row 1 team name in serif 16px ('디자인') with a right pill ('대표 차례' solid red on the 디자인 card, '진행 중' green outline on others, '1:1' grey on 총괄실); row 2 'R13 · 마일스톤 1 아트 디렉션과 건물 키트 컨셉' 12.5px; row 3 a thin 5px progress bar with '1/4' mono at the right; row 4 a compact number line '대표 차례 1 · 승인 대기 2 · 작업 중 헨리' with the first item red; row 5 three 22px round member chips with names ('헨리 클레멘타인 마크'), one chip with a tiny green dot; row 6 a small avatar chip + one line of the last message in grey with '3분 전'. The 디자인 card has a 3px red stripe inside its left edge. Keep everything crisp, aligned to an 8px grid, no lorem ipsum, all text in Korean as given, no English UI text except 'R13'. No decorative illustrations. Output a single PNG, 1700x900, white margin 20px around both screens, the phone screen scaled to fit the same height as the desktop screen.
refsNote: 타사 화면(네이버·레딧·ZEP 캡처)은 첨부하지 않는다 — 배치 참고는 설계 문서 0절에 글로 적었고, 그림이 그들 UI 를 베끼면 버린다.
after: 그대로 out/screens/tower-tabs.png 에 저장. 확인할 것 셋 — ① 개인 탭에서 대표 카드가 묶음 밖 맨 위에 고정인가 ② 폰에서 탭 줄과 카드가 한 열인가 ③ 빨간 것은 대표 차례·대표 부름·막힘 셋뿐인가. 글자가 깨졌으면 목업이라 넘어가고, 배치가 다르면 다시 뽑는다.
status: 요청 파일만 있음 — 하네스가 대표 통로로 뽑는다 (2026-09-13)
